summary: First-party English and isiZulu discovery found the South African Chief Surveyor-General national cadastral services and City of Johannesburg local cadastral/property procedures. REST schemas were inspected. One exact-point query timed out and the other returned no features; no GeoJSON sample is retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, actual URLs, request outcomes, schema/CRS observations, and the unchanged exact point are recorded in city-4161-diepsloot.json. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, or unsafe field request was used.

custodians.name: Chief Surveyor-General / Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
City of Johannesburg Corporate Geo-Informatics
custodians.scope: Local Johannesburg stand/property and cadastral map services and procedures.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:4326 for Planning_Cadastre; EPSG:4148 for CSG Erven layer
schemaAndCrs.fieldMapping: Planning_Cadastre: UniqueID, PropSrc, SG_CODE, PARCEL_NO, PORTION; CSG Erven: OBJECTID, GID, PRCL_KEY, PRCL_TYPE, PROVINCE, MAJ_REGION, PARCEL_NO, PORTION

scopeLimits: Exact point [-25.9317614563184, 28.0108704187243] was preserved and not shifted.
No full parcel polygon was retained because no safe native identity-plus-geometry response was obtained.
Exact-point miss and timeout do not establish citywide absence.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: The public Planning_Cadastre query timed out.
The CSG exact-point query returned no features but was not followed by an extent geometry query because the bounded request route failed.
No independent serial reviewer qualification has occurred.
doNotInfer: A timeout, empty exact-point result, or unusable viewer is not evidence of parcel absence.
National or municipal service metadata is not proof of complete Diepsloot citywide geometry coverage.
A schema alone is not a qualified runtime adapter.
